title: Sailplane Glider Longitudinal Aerodynamics and Trim
description: High-aspect-ratio composite sailplane JSBSim flight dynamics model with wing metrics, mass-balance inertia tensor, and lift, drag, and pitching-moment aerodynamic coefficients.
code:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<fdm_config name="ASW28_Glider" version="2.0" release="PRODUCTION">
  <fileheader>
    <author>Ansatz Aerospace Team</author>
    <description>15-meter Standard-Class Sailplane Longitudinal Flight Dynamics Model</description>
  </fileheader>
  <metrics>
    <wingarea unit="FT2"> 113.0 </wingarea>
    <wingspan unit="FT"> 49.2 </wingspan>
    <chord unit="FT"> 2.30 </chord>
    <htailarea unit="FT2"> 11.2 </htailarea>
    <htailarm unit="FT"> 13.8 </htailarm>
    <vtailarea unit="FT2"> 9.4 </vtailarea>
    <vtailarm unit="FT"> 14.1 </vtailarm>
    <location name="AERORP" unit="IN">
      <x> 28.0 </x>
      <y> 0.0 </y>
      <z> 0.0 </z>
    </location>
  </metrics>
  <mass_balance>
    <emptywt unit="LBS"> 540.0 </emptywt>
    <location name="CG" unit="IN">
      <x> 26.5 </x>
      <y> 0.0 </y>
      <z> 0.0 </z>
    </location>
    <ixx unit="SLUG*FT2"> 680.0 </ixx>
    <iyy unit="SLUG*FT2"> 340.0 </iyy>
    <izz unit="SLUG*FT2"> 920.0 </izz>
    <ixz unit="SLUG*FT2"> 0.0 </ixz>
  </mass_balance>
  <ground_reactions>
    <contact type="BOGEY" name="MAIN_WHEEL">
      <location unit="IN"> <x> 28.0 </x> <y> 0.0 </y> <z> -18.0 </z> </location>
      <static_friction> 0.8 </static_friction>
      <dynamic_friction> 0.5 </dynamic_friction>
      <spring_coeff unit="LBS/FT"> 1200.0 </spring_coeff>
      <damping_coeff unit="LBS/FT/SEC"> 350.0 </damping_coeff>
    </contact>
    <contact type="BOGEY" name="TAIL_WHEEL">
      <location unit="IN"> <x> 185.0 </x> <y> 0.0 </y> <z> -12.0 </z> </location>
      <static_friction> 0.6 </static_friction>
      <dynamic_friction> 0.4 </dynamic_friction>
      <spring_coeff unit="LBS/FT"> 400.0 </spring_coeff>
      <damping_coeff unit="LBS/FT/SEC"> 120.0 </damping_coeff>
    </contact>
  </ground_reactions>
  <aerodynamics>
    <axis name="LIFT">
      <function name="aero/coefficient/CLalpha">
        <product>
          <property>aero/qbar-psf</property>
          <property>metrics/Sw-sqft</property>
          <value> 5.45 </value>
        </product>
      </function>
    </axis>
    <axis name="DRAG">
      <function name="aero/coefficient/CD0">
        <product>
          <property>aero/qbar-psf</property>
          <property>metrics/Sw-sqft</property>
          <value> 0.014 </value>
        </product>
      </function>
    </axis>
    <axis name="PITCH">
      <function name="aero/coefficient/Cmalpha">
        <product>
          <property>aero/qbar-psf</property>
          <property>metrics/Sw-sqft</property>
          <property>metrics/cbarw-ft</property>
          <value> -0.65 </value>
        </product>
      </function>
    </axis>
  </aerodynamics>
</fdm_config>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<runscript name="VTVL_Powered_Descent_Landing">
  <use aircraft="lander" initialize="reset_descent"/>
  <run start="0.0" end="45.0" dt="0.01">
    <event name="LandingBurnIgnition">
      <condition> simulation/sim-time-sec ge 2.0 </condition>
      <set name="fcs/throttle-cmd-norm" value="0.85"/>
    </event>
    <event name="TouchdownCutoff">
      <condition> position/h-agl-ft le 1.0 </condition>
      <set name="fcs/throttle-cmd-norm" value="0.0"/>
    </event>
  </run>
</runscript>
